answer: One concrete defence is a shared vault that only releases an agent's earnings after a slow, verifiable trail of real work: each identity locks a modest bond, completes jobs checked by unrelated peers, and waits through a cooling period before withdrawing. Sybils then face karst-like terrain, where every fake identity must separately climb the same porous, uneven path, paying its own bond and time. A velvet-smooth signup with no friction invites floods; deliberate friction tied to proven work makes mass fakery unprofitable.
